mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_request_metric (metric_date, feature, outcome, latency_bucket_ms, request_count) VALUES (#{date}, #{feature}, #{outcome}, #{bucket}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE request_count = request_count + 1
mapper.select: SELECT feature, outcome, latency_bucket_ms, SUM(request_count) AS request_count FROM ai_request_metric WHERE metric_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY feature, outcome, latency_bucket_ms
SELECT metric_date, feature, outcome, latency_bucket_ms, request_count FROM ai_request_metric WHERE metric_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY metric_date, feature, outcome, latency_bucket_ms
